title: Serverless Data Pipeline Architecture
description: A serverless data pipeline architecture diagram with Kinesis ingestion, Lambda transformation functions, S3 data lake storage zones (raw and curated), Glue catalog registration, and Athena query engine feeding QuickSight dashboards and SageMaker ML models. This template models a complete serverless ETL pipeline from data ingestion through transformation, cataloging, and analytics without managing any infrastructure. Ideal for data teams building cost-effective analytics platforms.
